_meta.purpose: Key data domains. Copied field-for-field from the 'Data Available For Regulatory Assessment' table in Bank_Context_Fictional_Digital_Bank.md - coverage and known_limitation are taken directly from that table, not re-invented, so Agent 2/3 reasoning stays consistent with the rest of the team's material.
design_references: Bank_Context_Fictional_Digital_Bank.md — Data Available For Regulatory Assessment table

data_assets.name: Customer and Legal Entity Data
data_assets.known_limitation: SME ownership structures may require manual verification.

data_assets.name: Loans and Exposures Data
data_assets.known_limitation: Loan-purpose codes are inconsistent for older loans.
data_assets.notes: See 03_exposure/lending_portfolio.csv for the account-level detail this domain feeds.

data_assets.name: Mortgage Arrears and ARA Case Data
data_assets.known_limitation: Third-party servicer sends a monthly extract; some supporting documents are held outside NDB systems.

data_assets.name: SME Sector Classification Data
data_assets.known_limitation: NACE code missing or broad for approximately 20% of SMEs.
data_assets.notes: Matches sector_data_quality values ('validated_nace' vs 'broad_nace') already recorded in 03_exposure/esg_assessment_snapshot.csv - do not restate this coverage number differently.

data_assets.name: Geography Data
data_assets.known_limitation: Customer domicile and borrower operating country available.

data_assets.name: Consumer Circumstances and Material Changes Data
data_assets.known_limitation: Customer profile exists, but a structured re-confirmation event is not captured before every further sale.
data_assets.notes: This is the specific data gap behind the Consumer Protection Code exposure noted in the bank context.

data_assets.name: Payment Operations Data
data_assets.known_limitation: Volumes, channel, latency, failures, beneficiary data, pricing, and sanctions outcomes available.

data_assets.name: ICT Assets and Third Parties Data
data_assets.known_limitation: Application and vendor inventories exist; end-to-end dependencies and subcontractors are incomplete.
data_assets.notes: This is the data domain behind the DORA-relevant dependency-mapping gap - see 05_operations/dependencies.json for the concrete, per-vendor form of the gap.

data_assets.name: ESG / Climate-Risk Data
data_assets.known_limitation: No complete borrower emissions or physical-risk dataset.
data_assets.notes: Matches ghg_emissions_data_status and physical_risk_data_source values already recorded in 03_exposure/esg_assessment_snapshot.csv.

data_assets.name: Controls and Policies Data
data_assets.known_limitation: Existing control inventory is current; evidence links vary in quality.

data_assets.name: Treasury Liquidity Portfolio Data
data_assets.known_limitation: Position and instrument-level detail is complete for the small liquidity book, but the snapshot in 03_exposure/trading_book.csv is dated 2026-06-30 - over two months stale relative to this dataset's as_of_date of 2026-09-03. Fine for a static/derogation-eligibility read, not sufficient on its own for a requirement needing a current threshold check.
data_assets.notes: Was missing from the first pass of this file, since the original 11-row source table in Bank_Context_Fictional_Digital_Bank.md doesn't list treasury data separately - added to keep every business line covered by at least one data asset.
